format: Two square frames side by side, cropped at midpoint for WebP export

exercises.prompt: Use case: scientific-educational. Create a TWO-FRAME animation sprite sheet: exactly TWO equal SQUARE panels side-by-side, overall canvas aspect 2:1, NO divider, NO text, NO arrows. Each panel contains ONE entire athlete and entire apparatus, with generous margins. It will be cut at exact horizontal midpoint into two square images and alternated. CRITICAL: identical camera, perspective, scale, outfit, background and equipment coordinates in both panels; only moving body parts and attached moving equipment change. Reference image is style/character/equipment guidance. Keep same adult man, short dark brown hair, sage green tank top, dark green shorts, white athletic shoes, crisp dark outlines and flat shaded illustration. Replace ivory with uniform very pale blue #EDF2FF throughout both panels, subtle floor contact shadow. Clear anatomically coherent endpoint poses, no extra limbs, no duplicated arms, no crop. Three-quarter side view so both arms and motion are legible. Barbell flat bench press. LEFT: bar just above middle chest, elbows flexed roughly 90 degrees. RIGHT: elbows extended with bar vertically above chest/shoulders. Full continuous bar with weight plates on BOTH ends. Black flat bench, head resting, both feet planted, same torso and bench positions.
